repos.description: Java 面试 & 后端通用面试指南，覆盖计算机基础、数据库、分布式、高并发与系统设计。准备后端技术面试，首选 JavaGuide！
repos.summary_zh: JavaGuide 是 Java 及后端技术面试的权威指南，涵盖 Java 基础、集合、并发、IO、JVM、数据库、分布式、高并发与系统设计等核心知识。提供系统化面试题解析、源码深度剖析及实战项目（如 AI 智能面试平台），支持在线阅读与 PDF 下载，是后端开发者备战大厂面试的首选资源。
repos.summary_en: JavaGuide is the authoritative guide for Java and backend technical interviews, covering core topics including Java fundamentals, collections, concurrency, I/O, JVM, databases, distributed systems, high-concurrency, and system design. It offers systematic interview question analysis, in-depth source code breakdowns, and practical projects (e.g., AI-powered interview assistant), with online reading and PDF download options. It's the top resource for backend developers preparing for top-tier tech interviews.

repos.description: The Web framework for perfectionists with deadlines.
repos.summary_zh: Django 是一个高级 Python Web 框架，专为追求高效开发流程的务实开发者设计。它提供开箱即用的功能，支持快速构建安全、可维护的 Web 应用，内置 ORM、管理后台、认证系统和 URL 路由等核心组件，极大提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: Django is a high-level Python web framework designed for developers who value rapid development and clean, pragmatic design. It provides built-in features like ORM, admin interface, authentication, and URL routing, enabling secure and maintainable web application development with minimal boilerplate code.

repos.description: mall项目是一套电商系统，包括前台商城系统及后台管理系统，基于Spring Boot+MyBatis实现，采用Docker容器化部署。 前台商城系统包含首页门户、商品推荐、商品搜索、商品展示、购物车、订单流程、会员中心、客户服务、帮助中心等模块。 后台管理系统包含商品管理、订单管理、会员管理、促销管理、运营管理、内容管理、统计报表、财务管理、权限管理、设置等模块。
repos.summary_zh: mall 是一个完整的电商系统，包含基于 Spring Boot + MyBatis 的前台商城和后台管理系统，支持 Docker 容器化部署。前台涵盖商品展示、搜索、购物车、订单流程等核心电商功能；后台提供商品、订单、会员、促销等全链路管理。集成 Elasticsearch、Redis、RabbitMQ 等主流中间件，适合企业级电商项目开发与学习。
repos.summary_en: Mall is a full-featured e-commerce system with front-end portal and back-end management, built on Spring Boot + MyBatis and deployed via Docker. It includes product display, search, cart, checkout, and user management on the frontend, and supports comprehensive backend operations like inventory, orders, promotions, and analytics. Integrated with Elasticsearch, Redis, RabbitMQ, and other modern technologies, it serves as a robust platform for enterprise-level e-commerce development and learning.

repos.description: Memos is an open-source, self-hosted note-taking app that brings your everyday thoughts together in a personal timeline. Your data stays yours, and you choose what to keep private or share.
repos.summary_zh: Memos 是一款开源、自托管的快速笔记工具，专为即时记录设计。原生支持 Markdown，轻量高效，完全由用户掌控数据。提供简洁的时间线界面，无需分类导航，单命令部署，支持 SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL，具备完整的 REST/gRPC API，适合个人知识管理和团队协作。
repos.summary_en: Memos is an open-source, self-hosted note-taking tool designed for instant capture. Native Markdown support, lightweight (~20MB Docker image), and full data ownership with zero telemetry. Features timeline-first UI, single binary deployment, and extensible via REST/gRPC APIs for personal knowledge management and team use.

repos.description: LlamaIndex is the leading document agent and OCR platform
repos.summary_zh: LlamaIndex 是一个领先的文档智能代理与 OCR 平台，专为构建基于大模型的文档应用而设计。它提供数据连接、索引、查询与可视化能力，支持多模态输入与复杂推理，广泛应用于知识库问答、文档分析与智能检索等场景。
repos.summary_en: LlamaIndex is a leading document agent and OCR platform designed for building LLM-powered document applications. It enables data ingestion, indexing, querying, and visualization, supporting multimodal inputs and complex reasoning for use cases like knowledge base QA, document analysis, and intelligent retrieval.

repos.description: Self-evolving Context Database for AI Agents. Unify Agent Memory, Knowledge RAG and Skills.
repos.summary_zh: 生成失败
repos.summary_en: Generation failed

repos.description: Query Engine for AI Analytics: Build self-reasoning agents across all your live data
repos.summary_zh: MindsDB 是一个开源 AI 分析查询引擎，支持构建能直接访问数据库、数据仓库和应用程序的自主推理 AI 代理。它通过 SQL 兼容语言统一 200+ 数据源，无需 ETL，实现自然语言问答和语义搜索，适用于对话式分析、知识库检索等场景。
repos.summary_en: MindsDB is an open-source AI analytics query engine that powers self-reasoning agents to answer questions directly from live data sources like databases and data warehouses without ETL. It unifies 200+ data sources via SQL-compatible syntax, enabling conversational analytics and semantic search across structured and unstructured data.

repos.description: Free, simple, and intuitive online database diagram editor and SQL generator.
repos.summary_zh: DrawDB 是一款免费、简洁且直观的免费在线数据库关系图编辑器，支持可视化设计数据库结构并自动生成 SQL 脚本。用户无需注册即可直接在浏览器中创建、编辑和导出数据库模型，适用于快速原型设计、文档绘制和团队协作。
repos.summary_en: DrawDB is a free, simple, and intuitive online database schema editor and SQL generator. It enables users to visually design database structures, generate SQL scripts, and export diagrams directly in the browser—no account required. Ideal for rapid prototyping, documentation, and team collaboration.

repos.description: Python资源大全中文版，包括：Web框架、网络爬虫、模板引擎、数据库、数据可视化、图片处理等，由「开源前哨」和「Python开发者」微信公号团队维护更新。
repos.summary_zh: jobbole/awesome-python-cn 是 Python 资源大全的中文镜像仓库，涵盖 Web 框架、网络爬虫、数据库、数据可视化、机器学习等全领域工具链。由开源社区维护，提供分类清晰的资源列表，助力开发者快速定位高质量 Python 生态组件。
repos.summary_en: jobbole/awesome-python-cn is the Chinese mirror of Python's comprehensive resource repository, covering tools across Web frameworks, web scraping, databases, data visualization, machine learning, and more. Maintained by open-source communities, it offers a well-organized catalog of high-quality Python ecosystem components for developers.

repos.description: JumpServer is an open-source Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform that provides DevOps and IT teams with on-demand and secure access to SSH, RDP, Kubernetes, Database and RemoteApp endpoints through a web browser.
repos.summary_zh: JumpServer 是一款开源的堡垒机（PAM）平台，为 DevOps 和 IT 团队提供通过浏览器安全访问 SSH、RDP、Kubernetes、数据库及远程应用端点的能力，支持权限管理、会话审计与自动化运维，具备完善的 RBAC 权限控制与多协议支持。
repos.summary_en: JumpServer is an open-source Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform enabling secure, on-demand access to SSH, RDP, Kubernetes, databases, and RemoteApp endpoints via a web browser, featuring comprehensive auditing, RBAC, and multi-protocol support for DevOps and IT teams.

repos.description: ⭐⭐⭐⭐秒杀系统设计与实现.互联网工程师进阶与分析🙋🐓
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库聚焦秒杀系统的高并发设计与实现，涵盖Spring、Redis、MQ、ZK等核心技术栈，提供完整的高可用、高性能解决方案。项目包含多线程导入框架、JVM调优实战、分布式流程引擎等进阶内容，适合中高级工程师系统学习互联网架构核心能力。
repos.summary_en: This repository focuses on high-concurrency design and implementation of flash sale systems, covering core tech stacks like Spring, Redis, MQ, and ZooKeeper. It provides complete solutions for high availability and performance, including multi-threaded import frameworks, JVM tuning, and distributed workflow engines, ideal for intermediate to advanced engineers.

repos.description: Development at the speed of light
repos.summary_zh: SpacetimeDB 是一个基于 Rust 构建的分布式数据库系统，专为实时应用设计，支持边缘计算与区块链集成。它通过去中心化架构实现毫秒级数据同步，适用于游戏、物联网和去中心化应用，提供高可用性与强一致性。
repos.summary_en: SpacetimeDB is a distributed database system built in Rust, designed for real-time applications with edge computing and blockchain integration. It enables millisecond-scale data synchronization via a decentralized architecture, ideal for gaming, IoT, and decentralized apps, offering high availability and strong consistency.

repos.description: Python ProxyPool for web spider
repos.summary_zh: ProxyPool 是一个 Python 实现的爬虫代理 IP 池，支持定时采集、验证和更新免费代理 IP，提供 RESTful API 接口。项目具备高可用代理源扩展能力，适用于网页爬虫、数据采集等场景，支持多版本 Python 环境及 Docker 部署，显著提升爬虫反爬绕过效率。
repos.summary_en: ProxyPool is a Python-based proxy IP pool for web scraping, featuring automated collection, validation, and management of free proxies. It offers a RESTful API for integration with crawlers, supports extensible proxy sources, and enables efficient anti-scraping bypass via rotating IPs. Compatible with Python 2.7–3.11 and deployable via Docker.

repos.description: open-source agentic AI data assistant for the next generation of AI + Data products.
repos.summary_zh: DB-GPT 是一个开源的 AI 原生数据应用开发框架，集成 AWEL（智能体工作流表达式语言）和多智能体协作机制，支持多模型管理与 Text2SQL 优化，提供 RAG 增强生成能力，旨在降低企业级数据应用开发门槛，实现低代码构建定制化数据产品。
repos.summary_en: DB-GPT is an open-source AI-native data application development framework featuring AWEL (Agentic Workflow Expression Language) and multi-agent collaboration. It supports multi-model management, Text2SQL optimization, and RAG-enhanced generation, enabling low-code development of enterprise-grade data applications.

repos.description: 经典编程书籍大全，涵盖：计算机系统与网络、系统架构、算法与数据结构、前端开发、后端开发、移动开发、数据库、测试、项目与团队、程序员职业修炼、求职面试等
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库收录100+经典编程书籍，全面覆盖计算机系统与网络、算法与数据结构、前后端开发、数据库、测试、职业修炼等核心领域，精选伯乐在线及社区广泛推荐的权威技术读物，是程序员系统提升技能的理想资源库。
repos.summary_en: This repository curates 100+ essential programming books across core domains including computer systems, algorithms, web/mobile development, databases, testing, and career growth. It aggregates highly recommended technical reads from Jobbole and the developer community, serving as a comprehensive learning resource for programmers.

repos.description: TikTok 发布/喜欢/合辑/直播/视频/图集/音乐；抖音发布/喜欢/收藏/收藏夹/视频/图集/实况/直播/音乐/合集/评论/账号/搜索/热榜数据采集工具/下载工具
repos.summary_zh: DouK-Downloader 是一款基于 Python 和 HTTPX 的免费开源数据采集工具，支持批量下载抖音/TikTok 视频、图集、直播、合集及评论数据。具备 Web UI、API 接口、多线程下载、代理支持、增量采集、文件断点续传等功能，可部署至私有或公开服务器，适用于内容创作者、数据分析师等场景。
repos.summary_en: DouK-Downloader is a free open-source data collection tool built with Python and HTTPX, enabling batch downloads of videos, albums, live streams, collections, and comments from Douyin/TikTok. It features Web UI, API interface, multi-threaded downloads, proxy support, incremental scraping, and resume capability, deployable on private or public servers for content creators and data analysts.

repos.description: A Terminal Client for MySQL with AutoCompletion and Syntax Highlighting.
repos.summary_zh: mycli 是一个专为 MySQL 设计的终端客户端，支持 SQL 关键字、表名、列名的智能自动补全和语法高亮。基于 prompt_toolkit 构建，提供模糊历史搜索、多行查询、查询收藏夹、执行时间统计、SSL 连接支持等功能，并可通过配置文件自定义行为，显著提升数据库交互效率。
repos.summary_en: mycli is a terminal client for MySQL featuring auto-completion for SQL keywords, tables, and columns, along with syntax highlighting. Built with prompt_toolkit, it offers fuzzy history search, multi-line queries, favorite query management, execution timing, SSL support, and customizable config via ~/.myclirc, enhancing database interaction efficiency.

repos.description: Not Just A Notepad! (golang + mongodb) http://leanote.org
repos.summary_zh: Leanote 是一款功能强大的开源笔记应用，采用 Go 语言和 MongoDB 构建，提供富文本和 Markdown 编辑器，支持 Vim/Emacs 编辑模式、知识管理、协作分享及博客发布。它弥补了 Evernote 在代码高亮、实时渲染、跨平台支持等方面的不足，适合个人与团队知识管理。
repos.summary_en: Leanote is a powerful open-source note-taking app built with Go and MongoDB, featuring rich-text and Markdown editors, Vim/Emacs modes, knowledge management, collaboration, and blogging. It addresses Evernote's limitations in code syntax highlighting, real-time rendering, and cross-platform support, ideal for personal and team knowledge management.

repos.description: An open-source, self-hosted personal AI note tool prioritizing privacy, built using TypeScript .
repos.summary_zh: Blinko 是一款开源的个人 AI 笔记工具，采用 TypeScript 和 Tauri 构建，支持自托管以保障数据隐私。其核心亮点包括基于 RAG 技术的自然语言检索、轻量级跨平台部署（支持 macOS/Windows/Android/Linux）以及 Markdown 编辑功能，让用户能快速捕捉并管理创意想法。
repos.summary_en: Blinko is an open-source, self-hosted personal AI note-taking tool built with TypeScript and Tauri. It emphasizes privacy through local data storage and offers AI-powered RAG-based retrieval, lightweight cross-platform support (macOS/Windows/Android/Linux), and Markdown editing for instant idea capture and organization.

repos.description: 小红书（XiaoHongShu、RedNote）链接提取/作品采集工具：提取账号发布、收藏、点赞、专辑作品链接；提取搜索结果作品、用户链接；采集小红书作品信息；提取小红书作品下载地址；下载小红书作品文件
repos.summary_zh: XHS-Downloader 是一款功能强大的小红书（XiaoHongShu/RedNote）作品采集与下载工具，支持提取账号作品、收藏、点赞链接，采集作品信息及下载地址，批量下载图文、视频、LivePhoto 文件，具备断点续传、文件完整性校验、自定义命名格式、剪贴板监听、MCP 调用等高级功能，适用于内容创作者与数据收集场景。
repos.summary_en: XHS-Downloader is a powerful tool for extracting and downloading content from Xiaohongshu (XHS/RedNote). It supports fetching posts, likes, collections, and albums, downloading media files (images, videos, LivePhotos), with features like resume downloads, file integrity checks, custom naming, clipboard monitoring, and MCP integration, ideal for content creators and data collectors.

repos.description: chat log tool, easily use your own chat data. 聊天记录工具，轻松使用自己的聊天数据
repos.summary_zh: chatlog 是一款聊天记录工具，旨在帮助用户轻松管理和使用自己的聊天数据。由于微信官方函件指出其核心功能存在合规风险，项目于2025年10月20日被主动移除，仅保留说明文件。用户无法再获取代码或支持，建议删除本地副本以规避法律风险。
repos.summary_en: Chatlog was a chat log tool designed to help users easily manage and utilize their own chat data. Due to compliance risks identified in an official letter from WeChat, the project was voluntarily removed on October 20, 2025. Only this notice remains; no code, binaries, or support are available. Users are advised to delete any local copies to avoid legal issues.

repos.description: Private & local AI personal knowledge management app for high entropy people.
repos.summary_zh: Reor 是一款本地运行的 AI 个人知识管理应用，专为高信息密度人群设计。它基于 Ollama、Transformers.js 和 LanceDB 构建，支持自动关联笔记、语义搜索与 LLM 驱动的问答。所有数据本地存储，提供类 Obsidian 的 Markdown 编辑器，通过向量数据库实现智能内容检索与思维增强。
repos.summary_en: Reor is a private, local AI-powered personal knowledge management app for high-entropy individuals. Built on Ollama, Transformers.js, and LanceDB, it enables automatic note linking, semantic search, and LLM-based Q&A via RAG. All data stays local with an Obsidian-like markdown editor, offering intelligent context retrieval to augment thought.

repos.description: 🔥 基于大模型和 RAG 的智能问数系统，对话式数据分析神器。Text-to-SQL Generation via LLMs using RAG.
repos.summary_zh: SQLBot 是基于大语言模型和 RAG 技术的智能问数系统，支持对话式数据分析（ChatBI），实现自然语言转 SQL 查询并生成可视化图表。具备开箱即用、安全可控、易于集成等优势，可嵌入 DataEase、Dify 等应用，支持细粒度权限管理与持续优化，越问越准。
repos.summary_en: SQLBot is an intelligent data querying system powered by LLMs and RAG, enabling conversational analytics (ChatBI) with natural language-to-SQL conversion and visualization. It offers plug-and-play deployment, secure workspace isolation, fine-grained permissions, and seamless integration into platforms like DataEase and Dify, continuously improving accuracy through user interactions.

repos.description: 输入SQL，输出索引优化建议
repos.summary_zh: SQLAdvisor 是美团点评 DBA 团队开发的 SQL 索引优化工具，基于 MySQL 词法解析分析 WHERE、JOIN 等条件，智能生成索引优化建议。已在内部广泛应用，支持开源协作与持续迭代，提供完整文档与社区支持。
repos.summary_en: SQLAdvisor is an index optimization tool developed by Meituan-Dianping's DBA team, analyzing SQL queries via MySQL's native lexer to generate intelligent index suggestions based on WHERE, JOIN, and aggregation conditions. Widely used internally, it supports open-source collaboration with comprehensive documentation and community feedback channels.

repos.description: Redis-based components for Scrapy.
repos.summary_zh: Scrapy-Redis 是基于 Redis 的分布式爬虫组件，支持多实例共享任务队列与去重，实现高效分布式网页抓取与后处理。提供 Scrapy 即插即用调度器、去重过滤器、Item Pipeline 及基础 Spider，增强爬虫扩展性与并发能力。
repos.summary_en: Scrapy-Redis provides Redis-based distributed components for Scrapy, enabling shared task queues and deduplication across multiple spider instances. It supports distributed crawling, post-processing, and plug-and-play architecture with scheduler, filter, and pipeline components for scalable web scraping.

repos.description: 中国5级行政区域mysql库
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供中国5级行政区域MySQL数据库，涵盖省、市、县、镇、村完整行政层级，包含大陆地区邮政编码及经纬度信息。数据源自国家统计局官网，2023年版本在2020年基础上优化，共758,049条记录，支持高效导入与查询。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides a MySQL database of China's 5-level administrative divisions, including provinces, cities, counties, towns, and villages, with postal codes and coordinates for mainland China. Data sourced from the National Bureau of Statistics, the 2023 version refines the 2020 dataset, totaling 758,049 records, optimized for fast import and querying.

repos.description: Full featured redis cache backend for Django.
repos.summary_zh: django-redis 是一个功能完整的 Redis 缓存和会话后端，专为 Django 设计。它支持原生 redis-py URL 连接字符串、可插拔客户端/解析器/序列化器，提供主从支持、无限超时、Unix 套接字连接及原始 Redis 客户端访问，适用于高并发生产环境。
repos.summary_en: django-redis is a full-featured, BSD-licensed Redis cache and session backend for Django. It supports native redis-py URL connections, pluggable clients/parsers/serializers, primary/secondary setups, infinite timeouts, Unix sockets, and raw Redis client access, making it ideal for production-scale Django applications.

repos.description: 做最好的接口管理平台
repos.summary_zh: DOClever 是一款专为中小型团队打造的商业化开源接口管理平台，完全免费并支持内网部署。它提供接口全生命周期管理、可视化调试、Mock 服务、自动化测试、团队协作及多格式导入导出等功能，支持 HTTP/HTTPS 协议及多种参数类型，具备版本控制与快照能力，助力高效开发协作。
repos.summary_en: DOClever is a commercial open-source API management platform, fully free and supportable for on-premise deployment. It offers comprehensive API lifecycle management, visual debugging, Mock services, automated testing, team collaboration, and import/export in multiple formats. Supporting HTTP/HTTPS protocols and various parameter types, it features version control, snapshots, and seamless integration with Postman, Swagger, and RAP.

repos.description: Awesome Django authorization, without the database
repos.summary_zh: django-rules 是一个轻量级但功能强大的 Django 权限管理库，无需数据库即可实现对象级权限控制。它基于规则系统构建，支持复杂谓词组合、动态权限判断，并深度集成 Django 视图、模板和 Admin，提供高效、灵活的授权解决方案。
repos.summary_en: django-rules is a lightweight yet powerful Django authorization library enabling object-level permissions without requiring a database. Built on a rule-based system, it supports complex predicate logic, dynamic permissions, and seamless integration with Django views, templates, and Admin for efficient access control.

repos.description: A high performance open-source forum software written in PHP. Discussions Tags based with Quora/StackOverflow style.
repos.summary_zh: Carbon-Forum 是一款高性能开源 PHP 论坛系统，采用 Quora/StackOverflow 式标签讨论机制，支持移动端适配、实时推送、异步设计和完整 SEO 优化，具备现代通知中心与草稿保存功能，适用于构建高效知识分享社区。
repos.summary_en: Carbon-Forum is a high-performance open-source PHP forum software featuring Quora/StackOverflow-style discussion tags, mobile support, real-time notifications, asynchronous architecture, and full SEO optimization, ideal for building efficient knowledge-sharing communities.

repos.description: :books:Java核心知识点整理（包括Java基础、JVM、数据库、计算机网络、算法、操作系统、设计模式、系统设计、框架原理）
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库系统整理 Java 核心技术知识体系，涵盖 Java 基础、JVM、并发编程、容器类、数据库（MySQL、Redis）、计算机网络、算法（数据结构、LeetCode、海量数据处理）、操作系统（Linux）、设计模式及主流框架原理（Spring、MyBatis、Dubbo、Netty、Kafka、Zookeeper、Nginx、Tomcat）。内容结构清晰，适合 Java 开发者系统学习与面试准备。
repos.summary_en: This repository systematically organizes core Java knowledge, covering Java fundamentals, JVM, concurrency, collections, databases (MySQL, Redis), computer networks, algorithms (data structures, LeetCode, big data), operating systems (Linux), design patterns, and framework principles (Spring, MyBatis, Dubbo, Netty, Kafka, Zookeeper, Nginx, Tomcat). It provides structured learning materials ideal for Java developers and interview preparation.

repos.description: 完全免费、开源的多人协作记账 Web App | Completely free, open-source, collaborative accounting Web App
repos.summary_zh: Cent 是一款完全免费、开源的多人协作记账 Web App，基于 GitHub 仓库实现数据同步与版本控制，无需服务器即可跨平台实时协作。支持语音记账、AI 智能分析、多币种管理、地图可视化、周期记账等高级功能，采用纯前端 PWA 架构，数据完全自持于用户私有仓库，保障隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: Cent is a completely free, open-source collaborative accounting web app that uses GitHub repositories for data synchronization and version control, enabling real-time cross-platform collaboration without servers. It supports advanced features like voice记账, AI analysis, multi-currency management, map visualization, and recurring transactions. Built as a pure frontend PWA with data stored in user-owned private repositories for full privacy and security.

repos.description: 通用数据库 MCP 连接器：支持 MySQL、PostgreSQL、Oracle、MongoDB 等 17 种数据库，支持 Claude Desktop、Cursor、Windsurf、VS Code、ChatGPT 等 50+ 平台，用自然语言查询和分析数据
repos.summary_zh: Universal DB MCP 是一个通用数据库连接器，基于 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 和 HTTP API，支持 MySQL、PostgreSQL、Oracle、MongoDB 等 17 种数据库。它允许 AI 助手通过自然语言查询和分析数据，兼容 Claude Desktop、Cursor、VS Code、ChatGPT 等 50+ 平台，提供安全、高性能的只读访问与智能缓存优化。
repos.summary_en: Universal DB MCP is a universal database connector implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and HTTP API, supporting 17 databases including MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, and MongoDB. It enables AI assistants to query and analyze data using natural language across 50+ platforms like Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, and ChatGPT, with security-first read-only access and intelligent caching for high performance.

repos.description: Team IDE 集成MySql、Oracle、金仓、达梦、神通等数据库、SSH、FTP、Redis、Zookeeper、Kafka、Elasticsearch、Mongodb、小工具等管理工具
repos.summary_zh: Team IDE 是一款集成多种数据库（MySQL、Oracle、金仓等）、中间件（Redis、Kafka、Elasticsearch等）及开发工具的跨平台IDE。支持SSH终端、数据库可视化操作、SQL执行、Thrift服务测试、JSON/YAML转换等，提供终端透传、SSH隧道、节点管理等高级功能，支持单机和服务器部署。
repos.summary_en: Team IDE is a cross-platform integrated development environment featuring support for multiple databases (MySQL, Oracle, Kingbase, etc.), middleware (Redis, Kafka, Elasticsearch), and development tools. It offers SSH terminal, database visualization, SQL execution, Thrift service testing, and JSON/YAML conversion, with advanced features like terminal passthrough, SSH tunneling, and node management. Supports both standalone and server deployment modes.

repos.description: django-request is a statistics module for django. It stores requests in a database for admins to see, it can also be used to get statistics on who is online etc.
repos.summary_zh: django-request 是一个为 Django 框架设计的网站统计模块，自动记录用户请求至数据库，支持管理员查看访问数据、在线用户统计及流量分析。通过中间件集成和模板标签，可轻松实现用户活跃度监控与访问趋势可视化，适用于需要精细化运营分析的网站项目。
repos.summary_en: django-request is a Django statistics module that logs HTTP requests to a database for admins to analyze. It enables real-time tracking of online users, visitor statistics, and traffic insights via built-in middleware and template tags, ideal for monitoring user engagement and site performance in Django applications.

repos.description: AI-powered desktop SQL client. Cross-platform. Built with Flutter.
repos.summary_zh: openhare 是一款基于 Flutter 开发的跨平台 AI 驱动桌面 SQL 客户端，支持 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQL Server、SQLite 和 Oracle 等多种数据库。其核心亮点在于集成 AI 辅助功能，可智能生成、优化和理解 SQL 查询语句，显著提升开发者和 DBA 的工作效率。
repos.summary_en: Openhare is an AI-powered, cross-platform desktop SQL client built with Flutter, supporting multiple databases including MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, SQLite, and Oracle. Its standout feature is integrated AI assistance for generating, optimizing, and interpreting SQL queries, enhancing productivity for developers and DBAs.

repos.description: Django tools for building nonrel backends
repos.summary_zh: Djangotoolbox 是 Django 的非关系型数据库后端通用工具包，提供标准化接口支持在 NoSQL 数据库上运行 Django。它包含字段类型（如 ListField、DictField）、管理后台适配及权限处理支持，帮助开发者构建兼容 Django ORM 的非关系型数据层。
repos.summary_en: Djangotoolbox is a Django utility library providing a unified API for running Django on non-relational/NoSQL databases. It includes base classes for custom backends, specialized field types (e.g., ListField, DictField), and admin integration to support Django's admin interface without JOINs.

repos.description: Yet another django based blog created in May 2015
repos.summary_zh: MayBlog 是一个基于 Django 和 Bootstrap 开发的博客系统，于2015年5月创建。支持多用户、多角色、Markdown 写作、SEO 优化，并通过 Docker 实现容器化部署。提供 RESTful API（开发中）和后台管理界面，采用微服务架构设计，适合个人或团队搭建内容管理平台。
repos.summary_en: MayBlog is a Django and Bootstrap-based blog system created in May 2015. It supports multi-user, multi-role access, Markdown writing, SEO optimization, and containerized deployment via Docker. Features include RESTful API (in development), admin interface, and modular deployment configurations, ideal for personal or team content management.

repos.description: Django database backend for MySQL that provides pooling ala SQLAlchemy.
repos.summary_zh: django-mysqlpool 是一个基于 SQLAlchemy 的 Django MySQL 数据库后端，提供连接池功能，通过 Monkey-patch 方式无缝集成，避免冻结 Django 核心代码。支持自定义连接池实现与参数配置，有效限制进程级连接数，提升高并发场景下的数据库资源利用率。
repos.summary_en: django-mysqlpool is a Django MySQL database backend leveraging SQLAlchemy for connection pooling. It uses monkey-patching to integrate seamlessly without freezing Django's core, supporting customizable pool implementations and arguments. It helps limit per-process connections, improving resource efficiency in high-concurrency environments.

repos.description: Generate SQL query from natural language.
repos.summary_zh: GenQL 是一款将自然语言转换为 SQL 查询的工具，基于 Pinecone 向量数据库和 OpenAI 大模型技术，支持数据库模式索引、语音输入、查询历史记录等功能，适用于数据分析、应用开发和团队协作等场景，显著提升非技术用户与数据库交互的效率。
repos.summary_en: GenQL is a natural language to SQL translation tool powered by Pinecone vector database and OpenAI LLM, enabling schema indexing, voice input, and query history. It streamlines database interactions for data analysts, developers, and non-technical users, enhancing productivity in reporting, exploration, and app development.
